texts.zh: [landgrab_planet.GetName]传来了令人担忧的经济报告，我们的贸易商正在此地同[landgrab_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]进行贸易。当条约签署的时候，我们采取了一些措施来保障当地人的国家主权，但是我们中的一些人绕过法律，从当地的草场人手中购买了大片的土地。以目前的速率，要不了一代人[landgrab_planet.GetName]就会完全被私人贸易商给买空了。
texts.en: Concerning economic reports from [landgrab_planet.GetName], where our merchants have been trading with the [landgrab_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]. When the deal was signed, measures were put in place to ensure the sovereignty of the locals, but some of our own people are skirting the law to buy up vast quantities of land through local strawmen. At the current rate, within a generation [landgrab_planet.GetName] will be wholly owned by private traders.

label.zh: 撤回这些交易，对罪犯进行罚款。
label.en: Revoke the sales and fine the culprits.

label.zh: 一个发财致富的好机会……
